sources.title: Seamless Total Body Reformer — Class 6387
locators: Public transcript basic Supine Arms segment; web text lines 82–86; before optional curl/leg extension

context.type: educator-led class published on the educator platform
context.intendedAudience: Page labels Intermediate, Moderate Pace, Contemporary; full class uses Reformer with Box and Overball.
context.scope: Selected basic supine arm down/up phase only; not the whole class or later progressions.
context.educatorProvenanceNote: Publisher profile states comprehensive teacher training at Equinox in 2013. This establishes publication provenance only, not external credential verification or review of this proposal.

factualRecord.variant: Basic supine arms with tabletop legs and a ball between the ankles
facts: The instructor rolls down onto the carriage, places the ball between the ankles, and takes short loops or handles.
The setup leaves space at the shoulder blocks, reaches the arms above the shoulders, and brings the legs to tabletop.
The cue keeps knees from collapsing inward and moves the arms down and back up, with inhalation to lift and exhalation to press.

unknownOrNotEstablished: Numerical shoulder/hip/knee angles, elbow-lock instruction, exact hand endpoints, headrest angle, complete stationary contact map, exact carriage motion and rope route.
sources.useBoundary: Preserve ball-between-ankles/tabletop if calling this the selected variant. The later chest curl, diagonal leg extension, triceps press and coordination are separate progressions and are excluded. The directional wording does not independently certify straight elbows.

sources.title: Mat on the Cadillac — Class 1782
locators: Paragraph beginning She can have her long legs
Paragraph beginning All right, so if you would

context.intendedAudience: Page labels Beginner+; beginning/intermediate mat work using Cadillac springs
context.scope: Bent-elbow preparatory presses before a separate Hundred variation.
context.educatorProvenanceNote: Publisher profile describes the instructor as a teacher trainer, published author and Balanced Body presenter. Publication provenance only; not an independent credential check or proposal review.

factualRecord.variant: Supine arm-spring preparatory press, bent-knee/feet-planted option selected
facts: The client lies supine with the head toward the arm springs.
The instructor offers straight legs resting on the mat or bent knees with feet planted.
Preparatory presses begin with bent elbows and a downward push cue; the springs attach behind and above the client.
A later repetition adds head/shoulder curl and elbow straightening for the Hundred.

unknownOrNotEstablished: Precise preparatory hand endpoints, degree or timing of elbow extension, return path, full stationary contact map, anchor height/spacing, spring load/length or model dimensions.
sources.useBoundary: Select the bent-knee/feet-planted option without borrowing the later Hundred's straight elbows, chest curl or leg position. Constant bent elbows and the complete repeated hand arc remain authored choices.

proposals.selectedVariant: Zola Williams Class 6387 basic phase: supine, tabletop legs with ball between ankles, arms above shoulders then down/up; no curl or leg extension.
sourceCheckedContacts: Hands use short loops or handles.
Setup leaves space at shoulder blocks.
chosenVariantContacts: Use the loops option rather than the handles option.
Ball-to-ankle contact is represented in the schematic; ball size and contact geometry are authored.
authoredChoicesOrUnknown: Head, back and pelvis support geometry and headrest position.
Elbow angle and numerical shoulder/hip/knee ranges, hand height at either endpoint and interpolation/timing.
Pulley number/positions, carriage rope-attachment locations and symmetric rope-length kinematics.

proposals.stationaryContactBoundary: The source gives the selected pose and ball/loop contacts but does not provide a complete stationary contact map.
mappingConstraints: Do not claim exact equivalence to the original movement or to the source performance.

proposals.selectedVariant: Rachel Taylor Segel Class 1782 preparatory arm-spring presses; choose bent knees and planted feet; retain bent elbows in the authored arc.
sourceCheckedContacts: Feet planted is an explicit source option.
Head is oriented toward the arm springs.
Arm-spring apparatus uses frame attachments and hand handles/loops at the general apparatus level.
chosenVariantContacts: Use bent knees and planted feet rather than the straight-leg option.
Represent individual hand handles attached to spring elements using the apparatus manual's general topology.
authoredChoicesOrUnknown: Head/back/pelvis support contact positions and fixed-table representation.
